Player must have a 'Compete', 'Play' or 'Coach' membership of Badminton England.
Player without a 'Compete' licence will be required to pay an additional £8 'BE Competition Fee' per tournament.

You can upgrade from 'Play' or 'Coach' to 'Compete' at any point for just £16, which will last for the term of your membership. This entitles you to enter as many select Badminton England sanctioned tournaments as you like, without any additional 'BE Competition Fee'.
